name: Sanjou Miku
source:
A part-time resident of the mansion where Kenta lives. She is an apprentice of Japanese dance, but since she is married, she stays at the mansion and her own house at about a 50/50 split.

She likes Aoi's choreographed graceful behavior and her usual laziness. However, she is troubled a little with Aoi's behavior being more towards lesbianism than simple affection.

She and Kenta spent a lot of time playing together when they were little. Their relationship was one where Miku was a tyrant, and Kenta could do nothing to resist her. Their relationship since their reunion is practically the same.

She is one who always comments on the situation. She is never calm, but rather passionate in all she does. She often goes overboard when she speaks to Kenta.

Kenta has gotten used to living under the same roof with his old friend, Miku. Recently, their relationship has been changing, with Miku accepting Kenta's requests to have sex with her. Kenta wants to have a deeper relationship, but Miku also seems to have something on her mind. 

Miku begins to show reluctance towards Kenta. Will choice will Kenta make?

[From [Url=http://13cm.jp/game/bubu/index.html]official site[/url]]
